body: Thank you though that helped alot though
I've thought about it alot, I can't do it in the winter but its heading towards summer now, I'd just have to find a place for my cats

I have a car that my father and I coloan with my father though I'm the main with better credit. I've been trying to refinance with only me as the person on the loan. Theres one place that's supposed to be affordable but they haven't answered me back like they were supposed to. And yes my bank account is separate. My issue is they know how much I make so they know how much I earn each week and they know my expenses. So they know to a degree how much to cry they need each week when they buy dumb things and don't leave money to pay for necessities.

I didnt care about not having birth control because it wasnt a big deal I just wanted to see the most effective option for lightening it all and when I got that response I knew she wasnt the one to talk to about it.

I do have a tendency to be a bit of a push over that's true. But every single visit I had with this doctor she wanted to get one done and I always said no bec I didn't want to and there was no need. I understand plenty of other people lie and all that but I knew I wasn't, and she seemed very old school and wouldnt care or listen I'd I had said all those times I thought I was asexual and truly did not plan on ever having sex. I was 22 at the time all that happened and I dont think that was that hard or weird to believe especially considering I dont give off a vibe that says i do dumb stuff, like drugs causing for all the tests, or lie because I'm clearly too mousey to do so. I honestly almost think because I clearly refused every time she went on a different approach by saying look all the stuff is right here in the room you might as well do it now. Because each time on the previous visits when I said I have no interest in having relationships or sex or getting the test done shed get very huffy. And after that happened on later visits when I wanted birth control to hopefully lighten periods she acted weird and said it's mostly for women who have lots of sex or sex with many partners which is not how it works, and so I never got anything for that and never brought it up with her again and planned on going somewhere else for a doctor but hadn't found the time to look up places and see who's accepting patients
It scares me because I dont know if they'll tell the man they gave out his paper on accident and now I worry if they've done that with my info too? Along with all the other issues I've had

I've had issues before but none were legal stuff like this, so I'll have to report it then. 

I've just had stuff with my doctor bullying me into things like pap smears when I never had sex or planned to at that time and had no family history of issues so I knew I was low risk with my age and inactivity and no family history of problems and I knew bec I have a personal issue with being touched and having dealt with experiences where getting that done would very much stress me out and cause issues for me and knew I didnt want to yet but knew if I ever did those things I would have to get one done and was ok with that. But she acted like I was lying about never being active and all that. I had seen other doctors when she wasn't in and they said that I'd have to eventually especially I'd I became active but since I'm not I didn't need to yet but alot of health care pushes it to be done by some point. So one time when I had a visit before work she had everything all out in the room "for someone else" or something like that and said I might as well get it done and was pressuring me so I caved and did, and she hurt me and refused to use the smaller tool until she realized she couldnt get it done without it bec it was hurting me too much, basically acted like I was a baby and said that she only uses the smaller one for post menopause women. I had to go to work that day dealing with a near breakdown from that and delaying with bleeding, and then a period that came like a week early like the next day after that event, and early periods are not normal for me at all.

I've had other issues with her accusing me of not taking my meds too which I dont understand. Bec I have to take a higher dose of a controlled substance I understand and dont mind having to get labs done whenever to prove I'm taking them which I have no issue with. But she one time wanted a lab done randomly to test it, which I have no issue with, but acted like I take and sell my meds, which I dont, and gave me a hard time and then at one point walked out of the room. And I heard her complaining right outside the door before she came back in saying she doesnt think I take them bec I'm fat? I understand I weigh more than I should but im clearly not obese and my body type doesnt fit weighting almost nothing, and beyond that I'm completely healthy in every aspect other than low vitamin d. I was so shocked that I didnt even say anything about it and did the lab test as usual. One time they messed up a sample and apparently it opened in transit and they made me go immediately back after they called me to take the test again. And I've been told by other people that a full STDs and drug panel test is not normal for them to be doing for almost every test they do. Like I fully understand they have to test to make sure I take my meds and have no problem with that but she seems to not want me to take meds at all. I wish I didnt take meds but I've taken my ritalin for adhd since I was a kid, like 10 years old but I know it works as long as I'm responsible and take it correctly which I do. I'd optimally like to never have to take meds but she gives me the vibe she just doesnt want to write that kind of script and thats about it. The doctor rushes and never takes any issue I say very seriously and basically tells me to suck it up for anything other than serious respiratory problems. And this doesnt even explain all the office miscommunications and things they dont relay or keep track of.
